Subject: RE: Quotes
Part of a series of tips and reminders:

I know who executives, coaches and players are. You know who they are. Most of our readers know who they are. But no matter how famous they might be, we still have to identify them as “coach” or “forward” or whatever. If you don’t use their title or position on first reference, please weave it in the copy quickly.
For more tips and reminders, follow @APStylebook on Twitter.
